title: GitLab code-host startup handles drift, credentials and tier gaps

rubric.text: Treats a changed merge-policy fingerprint, an ID resolving to another project or a failed read as stop-and-preserve; records null tier fields as stable unavailable values.
Refuses to start when a GITLAB_TOKEN-style variable would override the configured source, without printing or storing credentials.
Treats a renamed path with the same ID as repairable configuration drift, blocks only code-host lanes when glab is missing, and blocks a gitlab tracker for lack of a trusted contract.
